job.title: [2027] Data Scientist - PhD Early Career - Safety
job.pay_full: $185,860 – $221,380 a year starting base salary (San Mateo HQ), plus equity eligibility

details.about: An early-career PhD role in Roblox's Data Science & Analytics organization, working on Trust & Safety. As Roblox grows, malicious actors try to compromise accounts and create fake ones for spam and phishing; this role uses machine learning and engineering to spot repeat bad actors across accounts quickly and to find patterns that prevent future abuse.
duties: Report to the Senior Director and partner with product and technical leaders to deliver insights that make Roblox safer
Investigate new ways to detect automated behavior on the platform
Develop models that identify new attacks and signals of malicious user behavior
Work with engineering teams to move detection systems toward real-time identification
needs: A PhD (held or in progress) in Computer Science, Applied Math, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, Economics or another technical field
Experience in statistical modeling and machine learning
Experience with deep learning / modern ML techniques
nice: Framing ambiguous problems and solving open-ended data science problems with business impact
Training or fine-tuning machine learning models
details.benefits: Starting base salary $185,860 – $221,380 a year for roles at the San Mateo, CA headquarters; actual pay depends on background, training, experience, location and market factors. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and benefits.
notes: Office-based roles are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, with Monday and Friday optional
Roblox says it may not be able to employ candidates with work authorization tied to certain US visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship, for this role

yt_title: Roblox Is Hiring: PhD Data Scientist, Safety (Early Career) | San Mateo, CA | $185K–$221K

scenes.head: The role
lines: Finishing a PhD? Roblox is hiring an early-career Data Scientist for its safety team in San Mateo, California.

scenes.head: What you'll do
bullets: Model new attacks and abuse signals
lines: You'll find new ways to catch automated and malicious behavior, like fake accounts used for spam and phishing, build models that spot new attacks, and help engineers push detection toward real time.

scenes.head: What you need
bullets: PhD (held or in progress) in a technical field
lines: You'll need a PhD, finished or in progress, in computer science, math, physics, engineering, statistics, economics, or a similar field.
Plus experience with statistical modeling, machine learning, and deep learning.

scenes.head: Pay
lines: Starting base pay is one hundred eighty-five thousand eight hundred sixty to two hundred twenty-one thousand three hundred eighty dollars a year, plus equity and benefits.
show: Starting base pay is $185,860 to $221,380 a year, plus equity and benefits.
